page: p. ~344-345 (ch. XXX, letter to a New York friend soliciting student sponsorship)
text: " My dear : Can or will you and your wife take one student each in our schools out here for 1891 ? It will only cost $150 each, and they can report to you every thirty days how they are doing. I have found a good many who have gone through college or seminary, especially ladies, who have no money — for they have spent all at school and have nothing to come here; but $150 will keep them hard at work for three hundred and sixty-five days, and they will do much good, and be learning all the time. My wife and I are each going to take one, and I am going to see if I cannot get two hundred others to do the same, and then it will not come heavy on any of us.
